title: Anchor
description: An exact position in a source: which document, which version, and where inside it. Carries the evidence captured at that position and the way back to it. At least one locator (meaning-based or geometry-based) must be present.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this record's schema (semver: major.minor.patch).

sourceId.description: Id of the Source this position lives in.

sourceRevision.description: The exact version of the source this position was captured against.

semanticLocator.description: A meaning-based address for the position (e.g. a text range or heading path) that can survive reflow, rotation, and format conversion.

geometricLocator.description: A geometry-based address for the position, kept as fallback and audit evidence when meaning-based addressing is unavailable or fails.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1, where the material is paged.

width.description: Width of the region in page coordinates.

height.description: Height of the region in page coordinates.

quotedEvidence.description: The words or content actually captured at this position, quoted as-is.

evidenceDigest.description: Digest of captured evidence that is not inline text (an image crop, an audio clip), as 'sha256:<hex>'.

resolutionStatus.description: How well this position can currently be found again: exactly, roughly, against an older version, or not at all.

returnRoute.description: The exact way back to this position in the source.
